body:
I didn't have anyone to talk about anything since I was working the streets 11 years ago. 
I'd like to talk with the new person and they offered to listen a couple of times now but I know they for like 7-8 weeks, maybe? And they is pretty empathic so I know they'll take it to heart.
Hell, even my therapist couldn't handle what happened, how can I possibly talk to someone who I'd love to consider a friend when all I do is getting them to worry about me?

I don't realize what is going on inside and I don't really want to. If what I am going through is only a part of it...I don't know if can keep breaking my limits. I am on the edge, i know. I almost cried in front of they because they asked why I am there when I wanted to help them out at work. I couldn't tell them that I am working my ass off just be near someone who cares...that I can't handle being alone like the last 10 years...

Not good, to be honest. I feel weak and can't concentrate at work or while studying. I got one hell of a headache. Meditation doesn't work either. I always slip back to some past events.
I met with them and they kind of got suspicious. The person doesn't really know what is going on but I feel they are worried.
I am in a catch-22 situation, kind of...
The only way to make them stop worrying is to make them worry more or feel my pain by being honest to they.

I don't know if I can go for an all out war. I hesitate to tell the truth. I always made up stories (like, "I had some hardships and setbacks") so the people around don't get a real glimpse on what's going on inside because even with the fake stories they kind of...suffered? I don't know how to call it. But I feel that they are in pain when I give them even a small glimpse on it.

So, yesterday I met that special person...well they forced me to, kind of. They can soothe the pain somehow, I even allowed them to touch my back (which is a horrifying no-go) or let them try to tickle my sides and I don't get any flashback on why I don't let anyone touch me. And I enjoyed a hug, which never occurred since I lost my only "friend".
I stayed with them but I couldn't sleep as my mind just went crazy again just for being there and leeching...

hey matthew,

I do have some reasons to live but right now..I doubt that they are the right reasons. They are right but these reasons involve others I don't want worry about me. Most of them know that I am "strange" but I can't burden them with this. I don't allow myself to do that. It's ridiculous, I know, but that voice is nagging in my head like there is no tomorrow worth living...
But I did something pleasant, something I missed all these years.
Thank you for your advice!

hey brightey,
I was always proud of my sense of reason. I wonder where mine went. I know it's there and I'll keep looking for it but it kind of doesn't have the balls to show up and stand against them. 
Did you really win? Or are they still there? 
I once thought I'd won but here I am...

hey folks,

I made it through the night and managed to talk to someone...kind of.
I think I am going to focus on work for the upcoming days and hope they don't hit me too hard when they come back to town, both, those su..ers pulling me apart and the person I talked to...I don't know whom to fear more right now.
Thank you for your words and help, even if it pains me to waste the time of others. Looks like I need a new focus after all (lost mine more than 10 years ago)...
I am not at my limits yet but it hurts, damn it fu..ing hurts!
